'''Jowdry''' was a man from [[Caemlyn]].

==Activities==
When Jowdry was at [[The Farrier's Green]], his throat was ripped clean out and his body was drained of blood. [[Matrim Cauthon]] heard of this when he was in Caemlyn, indicating the ''[[gholam]]'' was very near.{{ref/book|13|8}}
